text: #Clinic for those afraid of dentists. Today was my first time trying dental treatment here. I had a cavity at the age of 29 😳🦷. I'm usually afraid of dentists and hate going to the dentist, but I came because I know Dr. Pippo, a pediatric dentist. I booked an appointment with her because I thought a child dentist would be gentle 😆🤍. When I arrived, I was surprised to see so many children's toys! Once the treatment started, I was even more surprised when the doctor asked if I wanted to watch TV. So I asked her to put on a cartoon 5555 (but I had to wear glasses to avoid eye strain, so I chose Pikachu). During the procedure, the doctor kept telling me what I would feel, letting me know what stage we were at and how much was left 🤣. She didn't leave me wondering how long it would take! And importantly, she had a technique to distract me from the pain when injecting the local anesthetic. This was amazing! I followed her instructions, and before I knew it, it was all over 😌. I loved it – a new experience at the age of 29! If you're afraid of dentists, I recommend trying this place. Dr. Pippo is lovely and very kind!
